# IQ2 register-stage provenance

This experiment derives from independently fetched official Gufo at
`f783fedb9bea2ec7de941f6da4e02f4a4596b29e` through the recorded
`ssm-fixed-bounds` composition. Original Gufo/table notices and source licenses
remain. First-party generators, audits and patches carry SPDX MIT markers.
No sibling CachyOS source/artifact or another agent's DS4 work is imported.

The [initial1027-file source](../../config/q2-iq2-register-stage-source.json)
retains the shared-template attempt, including its broader compiled changes.
The [isolated1028-file v2](../../config/q2-iq2-register-stage-source-v2.json)
binds that donor, the retained parent, generator, patch and private include.
The original generic numerical template remains byte-identical in v2.
The literal parent control is differential evidence, not an independent oracle.

The cross-half-wave builtin is also used by the earlier first-party Q2
half-wave experiment. Here it moves the compact stage words instead of
sharing the earlier candidate's affine conversion. No third-party library,
dependency, model file, conversion format or persistent cache is added.

Source is durable under this worktree's `.deps/` with reconstructible tracked
patches. Static compiler evidence remains under
`evidence/q2-iq2-register-stage-preparation/`, including the initial audit
exit1 and corrected isolated audit. No remote source/build or GPU execution
has occurred for this candidate. Production promotion is not implied.
